en.headline: 3 commits, 4 issue actions, 1 discussion reply on openchamber
en.summary: sogeisetsu made **3 own commits** across two repositories on 2026-10-15, plus 12 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, two own commits updated the agents docs to explain commit-attribution aliases and fixed the daily script so commit attribution supports aliases, including commits authored with non-GitHub-account email addresses. In `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory`, one own commit tagged the release as `v1.15.5`. No pull requests, reviews, or releases were recorded. On the issues side, 4 actions were taken in `openchamber/openchamber`: opened #4920 "[Bug] Context panel breakdown bar divides whole-session estimates by the last message's input, so 其他 is always 0%", commented on #4111 "Deleting a multi-run leaves orphaned MCP child processes; git worktree remove --force then fails with Permission denied", and both commented on and closed #4346 "[test] SidebarHeader.test.tsx still passes onOpenMultiRun/canOpenMultiRun removed in d9fbf6b". The user also joined the existing discussion #4821 "[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel" in `openchamber/openchamber` with a comment. No truncation was reported for any section.

zh.headline: 3 次提交、4 次 issue 操作、1 条讨论回复
